subject: MAP & POC: Environment checklist and target close cadence
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@medistack.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: MediStack Procurement <procurement@medistack.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff & POC environment needs

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the platform looks promising for our charting pipeline. To get the MAP moving, procurement asked for a concise list of the POC environment items we need to close the pilot and sign. For our internal tech team, the high-priority items are:

- API keys scoped to our test org (read/write tokens, non-prod)
- org-level setup (team admin emails + zones)
- IP allowlist for the staging ingestion endpoints
- VPC peering options or private endpoint guidance (we're on AWS us-west-2)

Can you send a recommended sequence and target dates? We aim to verify integration within two weeks of access.

Also looping in procurement — can you confirm what paperwork they will need for a small proof-of-concept contract?

Appreciate it,
Alex
Alex Moreno
Head of Integrations, MediStack
alex@medistack.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@medistack.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & POC environment needs

Hi Alex — great to hear. I've sketched a short MAP and a one-page onramp checklist (attached) that maps the items you listed to owners and target dates. High level proposal:

1) Day 0 (within 48 hours): create test org, add listed org admins, and issue scoped API keys (limited TTL)
2) Day 1–3: provide IP allowlist guidance and verify connectivity to our staging endpoints
3) Day 3–7: complete VPC peering or private endpoint setup depending on your security preference
4) Day 7–14: run end-to-end ingestion test, iterate on any auth/network issues, and finalize acceptance criteria

Attachments: MAP-draft.xlsx (MAP owner/timeline), network-allowlist.csv (template), vpc-peering-template.txt

Hannah — can you own the technical checklist and confirm the peering template will work for us in us-west-2? Ben — I put you down as commercial lead for procurement/PO coordination. Marissa — please prep the short SOW/MOA we can hand to procurement.

Alex — once we agree the MAP dates I'll put a DocuSign MOA link in the same thread and we can lock dates.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Growth Ops — Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Alex Moreno <alex@medistack.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & POC environment needs

Vanessa / Alex — quick technical notes and a compact checklist so your infra team can act:

Checklist (for MediStack staging):
- Provide public IP block(s) for allowlist (we only need a /32 or small range) — sample CSV attached
- Provide service account emails to add as org admins; we will grant "POC Admin" role (read/write, no billing)
- API keys: we'll issue two keys — one for ingestion (higher rate), one for read/eval. Keys will be limited to 30d TTL for the POC.
- VPC peering: we support classic peering (exchange route tables) or PrivateLink-style private endpoint. If you prefer peering, we'll need a CIDR that won't overlap with our staging (we'll share ours).
- Test endpoints: 
  * ingest.staging.redwood.ai:443
  * eval.staging.redwood.ai:443

Proposed timeline (estimated, assuming quick approvals):
- Wed 22 Sep: Medistack sends IPs + admin emails
- Thu 23 Sep: We provision org + keys; run initial connectivity smoke test
- Fri 24 Sep: VPC peering day / private endpoint verification
- Mon 27 Sep: First full ingestion run + acceptance checklist

If you can confirm which peering approach you prefer I can prepare route examples and a short runbook.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai

To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & POC environment needs

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the clear checklist. We prefer PrivateLink-style private endpoints to minimize route table work on our side. Details below:

- Admin/contact emails: ops+redwood-poc@medistack.com, alex@medistack.com
- IPs for monitoring / fallback (if needed): 52.33.12.45, 52.33.12.46
- Our CIDR (VPC): 10.20.0.0/16 (no overlap with your staging 10.11.0.0/16 per your note)

Procurement: please confirm any requirements for the 30-day POC MOA. We plan to sign once we have the private endpoints and keys.

Alex

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & POC environment needs — alignment and next steps

Alex — perfect, PrivateLink approach works. Summary and agreed actions: 

- Action: MediStack to confirm admin emails & PrivateLink connector details (Alex) — target: 2027-09-22 (done)
- Action: Redwood to provision POC org + issue two 30d TTL API keys (Vanessa/Hannah) — target: 2027-09-23
- Action: Redwood networking to provide PrivateLink endpoint instructions and validate (Hannah) — target: 2027-09-24
- Action: Integration smoke test and ingestion run (MediStack + Redwood) — target: 2027-09-27
- Commercial: Ben to send MOA and SOW draft; Marissa to prepare one-page SOW for procurement — Ben/Marissa — target: 2027-09-24

Next meeting: propose a 30-minute sync on Mon 27 Sep at 10:00 PT to run the first full ingestion test and close the POC criteria. I'll send a calendar invite once Ben confirms MOA status.

Links: MAP draft and SOW templates are in our shared Drive: https://redwood.drive/shared/Medistack-MAP-v1
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/links/abc123-Medistack-MOA

Thanks everyone — will confirm when keys are live.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
